260:t_013:8.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「...It seems we're in a position closer to the center of the galaxy than before.」

260:t_013:11.en:
$$葵$$
「No way...! Then it's not just pointless, it's a setback!」

260:t_013:14.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, return to the ship. We'll sort out the situation.」

260:t_013:15.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Well, well... One step forward, two steps back... Things aren't going very smoothly, are they...」

260:t_014:0.en:
$$渓$$
「Great rhythm! Keep it up and we'll hit them with everything we've got!」

260:t_014:1.en:
$$號$$
「Understood. We'll combine everyone's strength and keep the chain of battle linked.」

260:t_015:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(So these are the parallel world's $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$... As expected, they're tough...)

260:t_015:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(But I have to get the data on these things to $$タイタン$$ no matter what...)

260:t_015:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(No... maybe there's no time left. If it comes to that, I'll do it by myself...)

260:t_016:2.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「T-to be brought low... in the face of a crisis for the universe... a disgrace...!」

260:t_100:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
(They're enemies I've never fought before, but somehow they feel familiar... $$ノノ$$ doesn't understand herself...)

260:t_101:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Parallel world or not, a space monster is a space monster!」

260:t_101:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Let's go, $$ディスヌフ$$! Exterminating $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$ is the job of the $$バスターマシン$$s!」

260:t_102:0.en:
$$チコ$$
「Could it be that these guys... are stronger than the $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$ we fought...!?」

260:t_102:1.en:
$$チコ$$
「Aaah! I don't really get it, but these guys... are hard to fight!」

260:t_103:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(We've finally met, parallel world $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$... Though I never imagined they'd look like this.)

260:t_103:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(That's one of my goals achieved. Now the question is how to bring this data back.)

260:t_104:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$... I thought survivors had been transported here along with me, but...」

260:t_104:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「If they existed in this world too, then $$ガンバスター$$ and I will take them on...!」

260:t_104:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Humanity won't perish...! We'll protect it, no matter what!」

260:t_104:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's my promise to $$コーチ$$ and Big Sis!!」

260:t_105:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「So the surviving $$ミケーネ神$$s had fled to the center of the galaxy!」

260:t_105:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「I wasn't planning to go out of my way to chase you, but if you've come to us, I'll take you on!」

260:t_105:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Come at me! If that's how you want it, I'll let you meet $$ハーデス$$!」

260:t_106:0.en:
$$ゼウス$$
(I feel it...! A crisis is closing in on this universe...!)

260:t_106:1.en:
$$ゼウス$$
(The collapse of the universe that comes once every 12,000 years...! No, that's not it...! An even greater crisis will arrive any moment now!)

kept_omissions: 260:t_013:10: Simon's 'we got sent back' - subject 'we' stated (scene settles it)
uncertain: 260:t_017:0: Kouji's stretched 'Zeuuuuus!!' written as plain English (Jigoku precedent) instead of a $$ゼウス$$ token, since a token cannot carry the elongation
260:t_013:14: F.S. 'return to the ship' - 帰還しろ has no object; assumed the ship (WILL's carrier) from the scene
260:t_105:2: ハーデスに会わせてやる rendered 'I'll let you meet Hades' (threat; no 'send you to' added)
260:t_104:0: Noriko's 宇宙怪獣 uses the plural token $$宇宙怪獣$$ (capitalised at sentence start); elsewhere |lc
